replicated_originals.reference: Román-González, Pérez-González & Jiménez-Fernández (2017) Which cognitive abilities underlie computational thinking? Criterion validity of the computational thinking test

A.reason: Ref [61] is the original study: the pre-registered paper sets out to replicate its findings on figural reasoning, visualization, arithmetic and gender differences in CTt scores, and reports which ones replicated (arithmetic did not).

B.reason: Ref [62] is cited once in the Discussion as background evidence linking figural reasoning to CT. It is a different study by the same group and is not the target of the replication.

notes: This is a replication plus extension. The extension adds numerical reasoning, algebra, mental rotation and visuo-spatial STM; those constructs are new and are not replications.
